MEMORANDUM THRU Contracting Officer, Mission and Installation Contracting Command – Fort Tolland

FOR Prospective Offerors, Solicitation W9124Q-27-R-0058, Facility Support Services (Custodial and Grounds Maintenance), Fort Tolland

SUBJECT: Section J, Attachment J-2, Real Property Inventory (RPI) Extract – Scope Applicability

1. References.

a. DoD Instruction 4165.14, Real Property Inventory and Reporting.

b. DA Pamphlet 415-28, Guide to Army Real Property Category Codes.

c. Solicitation W9124Q-27-R-0058, Section C, Performance Work Statement, paragraphs C.5 (Custodial Services) and C.6 (Grounds Maintenance).

2. Attachment J-2 is an unedited extract of the Fort Tolland real property inventory from the General Fund Enterprise Business System (GFEBS) as of 30 September 2026 (one worksheet, 89 records). It lists every real property record on the installation, not only the assets in scope of this solicitation. RPA_TYPE is the real property asset type recorded in GFEBS: BUILDING, STRUCTURE, LINEAR STRUCTURE or LAND. TOTAL_UM_QTY is stated in the unit of measure shown in PRIMARY_UM: SF – square feet; SY – square yards; AC – acres; LF – linear feet; EA – each; KV – kilovolt-amperes; KW – kilowatts; GA – gallons; MB – thousand BTU per hour.

3. Offerors shall use the extract as follows:

RecordsIdentified byUnitApplicability
BuildingsRPA_TYPE = BUILDING and PRIMARY_UM = SFSFIN SCOPE – custodial services, PWS C.5
Structures recorded in SF (open-sided covered storage sheds)RPA_TYPE = STRUCTURE, PRIMARY_UM = SFSFNot in scope – no custodial service
Surfaced vehicle parking (organizational and POV)CATCODE 85210, 85215SYIN SCOPE – sweeping and litter control, PWS C.6.4
Improved groundsCATCODE 93210ACIN SCOPE – mowing, trimming and edging (Type I), PWS C.6.2
Semi-improved groundsCATCODE 93220ACIN SCOPE – mowing (Type II), PWS C.6.3
Roads and streetsCATCODE 85110, 85120SYNot in scope – maintained by DPW Operations and Maintenance Division
Vehicle wash platformsCATCODE 21470SYNot in scope
Unimproved grounds and training landsCATCODE 93230ACNot in scope – maintained by Range Control (ITAM)
FencesCATCODE 872xxLFNot in scope
Utility systems and utility plant buildings (electric, heat, sewer, water)CATCODE 81xxx – 84xxxEA, KV, KW, LF, GA, MBNot in scope – utilities privatization contract

4. Records with FAC_STATUS “DISPOSED” or “CLOSED” are not in scope regardless of category or unit of measure. Only records with FAC_STATUS “ACTIVE” shall be priced.

5. FLOORS is the number of floors recorded in GFEBS and is blank for structures, linear structures and land. YEAR_BUILT is the year the asset was placed in service and is blank for land. RPUID is the DoD Real Property Unique Identifier; it is a record key, not a quantity. Facility numbers in the troop area were exported without leading zeros: 1101 through 1192 are facilities 01101 through 01192 on the installation maps.

6. The Contracting Officer has incorporated this memorandum in Section J as the cover to Attachment J-2. Questions regarding this attachment shall be submitted to the Contracting Officer in accordance with Section L. The point of contact for the real property data is the DPW Real Property Branch, (555) 010-7731.
